name: Eugenie Priscilla Raisa
source: Eugenie Priscilla Raisa is the eleventh in line for the throne, but she thinks of her royal blood as an inconvenience. Her days in the palace were spent listening to wandering bards and minstrels while avoiding the etiquette intructor.
